category_title: Reluctant readers who prioritize digital reading as a means to avoid traditional academic tasks
scenario_title: Avoiding regular English work during reading days
minimal_context: The student is completing a half-page reflective homework assignment at the end of a Friday Nook reading period in English class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have about ten minutes left in our Friday Nook reading time. Please go ahead and fill out the half-page reflective homework assignment on your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Do we have to? I most enjoyed about Nook reading day is that we are able to have an easy day with doing no homework and just read.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just answer the questions on the response sheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'd rather read than do English work. Being able to read from a Nook and no homework is why I like this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You've been using the Nooks for a while now. How do you feel about them compared to when we first started?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shrugs) She brought the Nooks in, and I was excited. Awesome…. After a while it's okay, Nook time, but I'm like okay as long as I don't have to do any English work.
